objective: Implement and validate fail-closed continuity, immutable artifact and duplicate-run safeguards.
expected_outputs: append-only run event schema with RESERVED and FINALIZED states
acceptance_criteria: synthetic tests cover duplicate IDs/hashes/acquisitions/runs and unresolved paths
preflight fails closed on scope lock and missing canonical records
all changes read back from GitHub
strict JSON Schema validation covers policy, active work item, artifact registry and run ledger records
cross-record checks reject duplicate artifact identities, hashes, acquisition fingerprints, run IDs and run fingerprints
CI invokes canonical governance validation and synthetic regression tests
workflow preflight adapter blocks all three existing local TSETMC workflow entrypoints before data/output access while research is locked
preflight accepts IN_PROGRESS work items and actual 40-character Git commit SHAs
synthetic tests detect immutable artifact tampering and missing/corrupt canonical preflight records
CI classifier allowlists only the three preflight-gated local TSETMC workflow edits
run reservation is atomic under an OS file lock and blocks identical fingerprints before execution
a failed or successful run remains in the ledger and blocks identical retries
run finalization appends a terminal event without modifying the reservation event
validator enforces one reservation and at most one terminal event per run, with unique fingerprint ownership
preflight_and_reserve_run performs preflight before atomically reserving the run fingerprint
run reservation and finalization records each validate against the versioned JSON Schema
generic unguarded JSONL append is not exposed for run-ledger writes
backup-copy creation uses exclusive create and never overwrites existing destinations
3-2-1 validator requires three locations, two media, two failure domains and an offline attestation
backup copy verification and restore verify exact SHA-256 and byte size
restore never overwrites an existing destination
synthetic backup/restore tests are wired into infrastructure CI
backup manifest validates against a versioned strict JSON Schema
backup manifest cross-checks copy identity, source hashes, 3-2-1 topology and successful restore evidence
research, analysis and backtest preflight requires at least one registered immutable input artifact and verifies its SHA-256
acquisition preflight requires a deterministic SHA-256 request fingerprint and blocks an equivalent registered acquisition
legacy research CLI remains fail-closed even after policy unlock until it accepts registered input manifests, validates the actual output path, and durably reserves/finalizes run-ledger events
CI scope classifier rejects absolute, traversal, backslash and control-character paths and parses changed paths with NUL delimiters
status_note: IN_PROGRESS; static audit fixed the scope-lock error precedence exposed by CI run 43794311916, hardened the legacy research CLI so it cannot authorize research without manifest/durable-ledger integration, required registered inputs for research/analysis/backtest and request fingerprints for acquisition, and hardened CI path classification against traversal/control-character/newline path ambiguity. All changes are authored/read-back only and untested. Remaining blockers: runtime schema/cross-record validation integration, actual workflow output-path and durable run-ledger wiring, historic run recovery, synthetic/exact-head validation authorization, and real 3-2-1 backup/restore proof.
